visual.issue: Photos 4, 5 and 7 show the page at about 0.7x its on-screen size: a near-whole page shrunk to fit, against r013. Month dates, week buttons and tile text are small at Etsy zoom, and over half of each photo is empty background.
Photo 2 enlarges the 2048 px screenshot about 2x as a bitmap rather than re-rendering it, so the italic labels look slightly soft up close.

First head start week (Oct 26 to Nov 1, Thursday Oct 29) is built under November, not October, so r008 week placement isn't met. The Oct 26-31 day trails correctly say 'October 2026', but that link opens the November 2026 page.
On the 79 head start pages the last two tabs become 'Nov 2026' and 'Dec 2026', so there are no tabs to Nov or Dec 2027 there. The 'Dec 2026' label nearly fills its tab.
Week 10 of the head start moves its prev/next arrows to mid-page beside the heading to make room for 'Continue to January 2027'. The other 61 week pages have them top right.
The January 2027 month page has no week button for Dec 28 to Jan 3, the week that holds Jan 1-3. It can be reached only from those day trails or the head start.
Photos 3, 8 and 9 leave the top third or so as empty background.
Some unused space: the lower left of Setup check below the fix list, and the bottom of each Lists column.
